questions.question: Who speaks in the third cycle, chapter 22?
What did Eliphaz now accuse Job of?
options: Mere laziness and the neglect of all his duties
No real sin he could actually name
Great wickedness, wronging the poor and needy
questions.answer: Great wickedness, wronging the poor and needy

questions.question: Eliphaz urged Job to agree with God and be at peace, and good would come to him.
Eliphaz told Job to return to the Almighty and he would be _____.
Eliphaz said if Job laid up gold and treated the Almighty as his gold, he would delight in the _____.
